title: Recycle Rush: Restore Verdale
description: Restore a community recovery station with Circuit in five untimed story missions featuring preparation, reuse, repair, local acceptance rules, animated characters, saved checkpoints and original music. Includes the 20-mission arcade campaign and endless Loop Mode.

controls.action: Inspect and route an item in story missions; prepare it first when needed.

controls.key: Arcade: tap or drag item to bin
controls.action: Choose its material destination. A/D or arrows selects a bin; Enter routes the lowest item.
Clear arcade hazards / activate the collected arcade power-up.
Pause, adjust music and effects, retry the current story area or return to the map.
